title: Design a Business Model
not_for: Selecting exact prices or constructing a financial forecast before identifying who pays.
input_gate: Compare coherent value and money flows; free participants need an explicit payer or funding mechanism.

models.incentive_risk: Heavy users may consume disproportionate support

selection.reason: Predictable charge matches a monthly workflow
selection.next_test: Offer a bounded paid pilot without claiming prior demand

example_note: The model can be chosen provisionally before a precise price is known. Make its payment timing usable in the cash forecast.
failure_case: A selected model absent from the alternatives or an unnamed payer is incomplete.
